newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MIDF gets okay to list its bank unit.
newsitem.headline: MIDF gets okay to list its bank unit.

text.p: Malaysian Industrial Development Finance Bhd (MIDF) said it has received approval from the central bank to list its banking subsidiairy, Oriental Bank Bhd.
The plan to float the bank on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange is subject to approvals from other relevant regulatory bodies, MIDF said in a statement late on Thursday.
Oriental Bank, 73.9 percent owned by financial group MIDF, had 41 branches in Malaysia as at end-March this year.

According to MIDF's annual report, the bank reported a 57 percent rise in pretax profit to 64.12 million ringgit for the year ended March 31, 1966. Net interest income rose 60 percent to 139.1 million ringgit.
